verses.text: "Make the holy tent with ten curtains of fine twisted linen and blue, purple, and red yarn. Have a skilled worker sew cherubim into them.
Every curtain is to be the same size, about twelve and a half metres long and almost two metres wide.
Join five of the curtains together, and do the same with the other five.
Make loops of blue cloth along the edge of the end curtain in the first set, and do the same on the end curtain in the second set.
Make fifty loops on the one curtain, and fifty loops on the end curtain of the second set, with the loops facing each other.
Then make fifty gold hooks and use them to join the two sets of curtains together, so that the holy tent is one whole.
Make curtains of goat hair to make a tent over the holy tent. Make eleven of these curtains.
All eleven curtains are to be the same size, about thirteen and a half metres long and almost two metres wide.
Join five of the curtains together into one set, and the other six into another set. Fold the sixth curtain double at the front of the tent.
Make fifty loops along the edge of the end curtain in the first set, and fifty loops along the edge of the end curtain in the second set.
Then make fifty bronze hooks and put them in the loops to join the tent together, so that it is one whole.
The extra half curtain that is left over is to hang down at the back of the holy tent.
The tent curtains will be half a metre longer on each side. What is left over will hang down over the sides of the holy tent to cover it.
Make a covering for the tent out of ram skins dyed red, and over that a covering of fine leather.
Make upright frames of acacia wood for the holy tent.
Each frame is to be about four and a half metres long and seventy centimetres wide.
Each frame is to have two pegs to fit them together. Make all the frames of the holy tent in this way.
Make twenty frames for the south side of the holy tent.
Make forty silver bases to go under the twenty frames, two bases for each frame, one under each peg.
For the other side, the north side of the holy tent, make twenty frames,
and forty silver bases, two under each frame.
Make six frames for the back of the holy tent, the west end.
Make two frames for the corners at the back of the holy tent.
At these two corners the frames are to be double from the bottom all the way to the top, held by a single ring. Make both corners like this.
So there will be eight frames and sixteen silver bases, two under each frame.
Also make crossbars of acacia wood: five for the frames on one side of the holy tent,
five for the frames on the other side, and five for the frames on the west side at the back.
The middle crossbar is to go all the way from one end to the other, halfway up the frames.
Cover the frames with gold, and make gold rings to hold the crossbars. Cover the crossbars with gold too.
Set up the holy tent exactly the way you were shown on the mountain.
Make a curtain of blue, purple, and red yarn and fine twisted linen. Have a skilled worker sew cherubim into it.
Hang it with gold hooks on four posts of acacia wood covered with gold, standing on four silver bases.
Hang the curtain from the hooks, and put the ark of the covenant behind the curtain. The curtain will separate the Holy Place from the Most Holy Place.
Put the cover, the place of mercy, on the ark of the covenant in the Most Holy Place.
Put the table outside the curtain on the north side of the holy tent. Put the lampstand across from the table on the south side.
For the entrance of the tent, make a screen of blue, purple, and red yarn and fine twisted linen, the work of someone who sews beautiful patterns.
Make gold hooks for this screen, and five posts of acacia wood covered with gold. Make five bronze bases for them.
